regions.description: Agrarian sugar belt, Jat-Muslim dynamics, high farmer mobilization (BKU), and NCR industrial-urban hubs.
Upper Gangetic plains, brass & artisanal handicraft centres, high minority concentration, and intense triangular contests.
State capital corridor around Lucknow, administrative hub, and traditional socialist and royal political bastions.
Drought-prone rugged southern plateau, severe water distress, agrarian poverty, and strong distinct cultural identity.
Varanasi-Gorakhpur Bhojpuri heartland, dense rural population, weaver clusters, intense caste polarization, and high out-migration.
Eastern Maharashtra agrarian & cotton belt; high farmer distress with acute political volatility.
Drought-prone central plateau; intense social mobilization and deep caste competition.
Financial capital and coastal belt; dense urban infrastructure, high business and media influence.
Khandesh & tribal belt; agricultural produce markets and cooperative banking networks.
Sugar belt and cooperative heartland; prosperous rural institutions and influential political networks.
Historic Champaran indigo heartland and Gandak basin; sugar mills, dense agrarian population, and acute flood vulnerability.
Kosi river floodplains, Maithili cultural core around Darbhanga-Madhubani, and intricate social-caste balancing.
Purnia-Kishanganj corridor bordering Bengal & Nepal; high minority population, chronic erosion, and heavy labor out-migration.
State capital corridor around Patna and Gaya; ancient administrative centre, educational hubs, and intense Kurmi-Yadav-Dalit competition.
Bhojpuri heartland along the Son river combined with Bhagalpur silk belt; rich agrarian heritage and deep political mobilization.

events.headline: Devastating Kutch Earthquake
events.description: A massive 7.7 magnitude earthquake strikes Kutch, Gujarat, killing over 20,000 people and devastating infrastructure.

reactions.label: Demand Judicial Probe into Building Code Violations
Dispatch YDP Aid Teams Without Public Statements

events.headline: Stock Market Crash & Ketan Parekh Scam
events.description: Stock market collapses following revelations of circular trading, bank fund rigging, and Madhavpura Bank failure.

reactions.label: Lead Nationwide Protests for Small Investors
Issue Press Release Calling for SEBI Autonomy

events.headline: Tehelka Defense Procurement Sting Operation
events.description: Undercover journalists expose bribery in military contracts, triggering high-profile political resignations.

reactions.label: Demand Immediate Dissolution of Lok Sabha

events.headline: Agra Peace Summit (Vajpayee - Musharraf)
events.description: High-stakes summit in Agra between PM Vajpayee and President Musharraf ends without a joint declaration over Kashmir.

reactions.label: Back Prime Minister's Firm Stance on Cross-Border Terror
Protest Failure to Secure Firm Anti-Terror Guarantees

events.headline: ISRO Successfully Launches GSLV-D1 / GSAT-1
events.description: ISRO achieves milestone with first launch of Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle from Sriharikota.

reactions.label: Highlight Need for Higher R&D & Tech Budget
Issue Congratulatory Statement on Space Mission

events.headline: Enron Dabhol Power Plant Collapse
events.description: Dabhol Power Company shuts down operations after power tariff disputes, leaving state utility MSEB in deep debt.

reactions.label: Support Govt Plan to Restructure Power Contracts
Lead Workers Protests Against Foreign Power Monopolies
Blame State Govt Mismanagement & High Tariffs
Advocate for Renewable Energy Transition Plan

events.headline: Ban on Students Islamic Movement of India (SIMI)
events.description: Union Home Ministry bans SIMI under Unlawful Activities Prevention Act following anti-national activities.

reactions.label: Fully Endorse Ban on Extremist Groups
Demand Strict Safeguards Against Misuse of Law
Question Procedure & Demand Special Judicial Review
Call for Zero Tolerance on Terrorism and Hate Speech

events.headline: Post-9/11 Global Anti-Terror Security Shift
events.description: Following 9/11 attacks in US, India offers full intelligence cooperation, reframing cross-border terror in South Asia.

reactions.label: Support Govt Alignment with Global Anti-Terror Coalition
Demand Immediate Military Action Against Terror Camps
Warn Against Strategic Over-Reliance on Foreign Powers

events.headline: Golden Quadrilateral Highway Project Acceleration
events.description: NDA Govt accelerates construction of 5,846 km 4-lane highway network connecting Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.

reactions.label: Demand Fair Compensation & Rehabilitation for Farmers
Audit Highway Tender Allocations & Cost Overruns
Propose Feeder Roads Connectivity for Villages

events.headline: Terrorist Attack on Indian Parliament
events.description: Armed terrorists attack Parliament Complex in Delhi; security forces neutralize attackers, preventing massive loss.

reactions.label: Stand United Behind Government's Defense Mobilization
Demand Security Audit & Home Minister Accountability
Honor Fallen Security Personnel in National Tribute

events.headline: Operation Parakram Military Stand-off
events.description: India deploys nearly 500,000 troops along Pakistan border in massive military mobilization post-Parliament attack.

reactions.label: Support Armed Forces Deployment & Strategic Pressure
Demand Swift Decisive Action Rather Than Prolonged Stand-off
Criticize Economic Burden & Risk of Nuclear Escalation
Support Army Readiness While Urging Diplomatic Resolution

events.headline: Godhra Incident & Gujarat Communal Violence
events.description: Sabarmati Express burning in Godhra triggers widespread communal violence across Gujarat state.

reactions.label: Defend State Law & Order Operations and Army Deployment
Organize Peace Marches & Immediate Relief Camps
Demand Immediate Resignation of Chief Minister & Army Control
Call for National Harmony & All-Party Delegation Visit

events.headline: Historic Joint Sitting of Parliament Passes POTA
events.description: NDA Govt convenes rare Joint Sitting of Parliament (only 3rd in Indian history) to pass POTA after Rajya Sabha rejection.

reactions.label: Vote YES to Strengthen National Anti-Terror Laws
Agitate Against Executive Overreach & Civil Right Risks
Vote NO & Stage Parliament Walkout Against Draconian Provisions

events.headline: Unit Trust of India (UTI US-64) Financial Bailout
events.description: Govt announces Rs 14,500 crore bailout package for UTI US-64 scheme to protect millions of small retail investors.

reactions.label: Support Govt Intervention to Protect Small Investors
Oppose Taxpayer Bailout of Financial Mismanagement
Propose Mandatory Insurance for Public Mutual Funds

events.headline: First Delhi Metro Rail Operational Trial
events.description: PM Vajpayee inaugurates first section of Delhi Metro (Shahdara to Tis Hazari), revolutionizing urban transit.

reactions.label: Praise Technological Marvel & E. Sreedharan's Vision
Demand Expansion to Tier-2 Cities Nationwide
Issue Congratulatory Note to Project Engineers

legislativeBills.title: Prevention of Terrorism Act (POTA), 2002
legislativeBills.description: Special anti-terror law expanding police detention powers and admissibility of confessions.

legislativeBills.title: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act, 2003
legislativeBills.description: Statutory framework mandating reduction of fiscal deficits and ensuring long-term fiscal stability.

legislativeBills.title: Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005
legislativeBills.description: Landmark transparency law guaranteeing citizen access to public records and government files.

stateIssues.title: Caste Violence & Social Justice
stateIssues.description: Escalating inter-caste violence, Dalit atrocities, and friction over representation in state bureaucracy.

stateIssues.title: Law & Order Collapse & Mafia Raj
stateIssues.description: Organized extortion gangs, political patronage for crime lords, and rampant highway robberies.

stateIssues.title: Sugarcane Arrears & Agrarian Distress
stateIssues.description: Millions owed to sugarcane growers by defaulting private sugar mills, triggering farmer demonstrations.

stateIssues.title: Identity Polarization & Reservation Clashes
stateIssues.description: High-voltage electoral mobilization around backward class sub-quotas and upper caste backlash.

stateIssues.title: Chronic Power Deficit & Grid Collapse
stateIssues.description: Severe load-shedding of 16+ hours a day in Purvanchal and Bundelkhand, paralyzing local workshops.

stateIssues.title: 'Jungle Raj' & Lawlessness
stateIssues.description: Kidnapping for ransom operates as a parallel industry with alleged political impunity across Patna and districts.

stateIssues.title: Caste Polarization & Private Senas
stateIssues.description: Feudal private militias and armed agrarian uprisings clash in central Bihar's rural heartland.

stateIssues.title: Kosi Flood Devastation & Embankment Breaches
stateIssues.description: Annual monsoon inundations sweep North Bihar villages amid corruption allegations in embankment contracts.

stateIssues.title: Education Decay & Examination Paper Leaks
stateIssues.description: Teacher absenteeism, ghost colleges, and widespread cheating scandals erode state degree credibility.

stateIssues.title: Potholed Highways & Healthcare Collapse
stateIssues.description: Dilapidated National and State highways isolate remote blocks, while primary healthcare centers lack doctors.

stateIssues.title: Vidarbha Agrarian Crisis & Farmer Suicides
stateIssues.description: BT Cotton crop failures, spiraling moneylender debts, and unseasonal weather trigger alarming suicide rates.

stateIssues.title: Mumbai Infrastructure Strain & Slum Transit
stateIssues.description: Overcrowded local trains, slum rehabilitation standoffs, and seasonal flood vulnerability in the financial capital.

stateIssues.title: Coalition Instability & Alliance Friction
stateIssues.description: Constant skirmishes between Congress-NCP partners and vocal regional resistance from the Shiv Sena-BJP front.

stateIssues.title: Girni Kamgar (Mill Workers) Displacement
stateIssues.description: Redevelopment of Central Mumbai textile mill lands into luxury complexes leaves thousands of workers unpaid.

stateIssues.title: Development Gap: Western MH vs Marathwada
stateIssues.description: Disproportionate allocation of state irrigation and industrial budgets favoring sugar belt baronies.
